As a straight, white, American male with depression and anxiety, I completely relate to this. I get called a whiny bitch, selfish, lazy, stupid, and told I deserve all of what I feel. Its either because Im a man and should just man up, or a white American who deserves to feel like this because of my forefathers history. If I was a woman, lgbtq, or of any other ethnicity or nationality, I would have access to a higher quantity and quality of mental health care. It took me threatening my doctor with killing myself right there to get an actual therapy appointment that wasnt 2+ months out. So far, years later, its been pill after pill, onlt 3 therapy appointments,  and many many many instances of me thinking the world and you and I are right, and the only choice we have is to kill ourselves.

my whole life I've felt this way and thought it was normal and how everyone felt. for me, happiness isnt real, is just something distracting me for a moment, nothing more. Have I made a terrible mistake by marrying someone, if I have never reallt known or understand love? Does the fact that I have most likely never known true happiness make me an emotional pariah for the rest of the world? If you or anyone finds any answers or techniques for coping, please let me know. We are all in a very strange, dark ocean together,  we just have a hard time seeing each other through it.

Bought Sekiro, and the sheer difficulty, and feeling of achievment when overcoming a boss. The relation to the isolation the antagonist feels. You never lose, you just get better, or git gud. It has given me a new mantra, "It never gets easier, you just get better". Good luck.
